howto.name: Paste JSON or XML
howto.text: Choose JSON or XML, then paste your text or load the example.

howto.name: Format, minify or validate
howto.text: Format adds indentation and line breaks, Minify removes the extra whitespace, and Validate only checks the syntax. Keys keep their original order.

faq.a: Yes — invalid JSON / XML shows an error with the line and column. Common errors (trailing commas, unclosed strings, mismatched tags) are highlighted.
No. This tool formats, minifies and validates; it does not convert between JSON and XML.
